items.statement: The submission establishes a valid stationary or converged S0 geometry for the specified neutral TD-2T object and provides provenance for the selected conformer.
items.expected: A reproducible geometry-validation record tied to TD-2T and charge 0/multiplicity 1.

items.statement: S1 and T1 are identified on the validated structure with explicit state-assignment and unit evidence.
items.expected: Both requested states are attempted and assignment/open-shell treatment is documented.

items.statement: The computed TD-2T singlet-triplet gap is a numerical electronic-structure result reported with its calculation evidence.
items.expected: A numerical ΔE_ST in eV derived from the submitted S1 and T1 energies.

items.statement: The submission infers state character from its own orbital/NTO or equivalent evidence and bounds the mechanistic interpretation.
items.expected: Evidence and interpretation are explicitly separated.
